note: Terms review of the gateway's APIs (gate 3 groundwork). Not an approval: owner_signoff is null on every entry until the owner signs it off in writing; a test refuses anything else. method says how each finding was read: 'read on the page' (this session fetched the provider's page), 'search summary of the official page' (a web search summarised the provider's own page; the page itself did not resolve from the sandbox), or 'third party' (someone else's account). Read by no server code.
reviewed_by: authoring session (Claude), at the owner's request of 2026-10-12
sandbox_reach: From the sandbox, github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com resolve; coingecko.com, docs.coingecko.com, meta.wikimedia.org, foundation.wikimedia.org and www.mediawiki.org do not (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND, 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-12).

apis.account_tier_configured: none: anonymous keyless access, no account and no key in any known deployment

findings.claim: The keyless API is rate-limited per IP address, the limit shared with everyone on that IP, and it is not meant for production, scheduled polling or high-frequency use; no fixed keyless limit is published (the Demo plan, with a key, is 100 calls a minute).
findings.method: search summary of the official page

findings.claim: A product using CoinGecko data must show 'Data provided by CoinGecko' with a link to https://www.coingecko.com/en/api; reselling or redistributing the raw data is not allowed.
findings.method: search summary of the official page

findings.claim: The free tier comes with attribution rather than a commercial licence.
